title: Final HEPA Vacuuming Area and Line Amount for Water Damage Mitigation
content:
Water Damage Mitigation — pricing the final HEPA vacuuming line.

**Clause.** Once drying is complete, the surfaces a tear-out exposed are HEPA vacuumed once in the final cleaning and billed as one final HEPA vacuuming line in square feet, dated the job's drying complete date; a job that already carries a HEPA vacuuming line, or that carries no pad removal or carpet removal line, is billed no final HEPA vacuuming line. The vacuumed floor is the total square feet on the job's pad removal and carpet removal lines. The vacuumed wall, contents and plate areas are zero, and the pass factors are 1. The billed square feet are the vacuumed floor plus the vacuumed wall, contents and plate areas, multiplied by every pass factor that applies to the job and rounded to two decimals, half up; the line amount is the billed square feet multiplied by the tier's HEPA vacuuming rate per square foot, rounded to the cent, half up. Amounts are rounded to the cent, half up.

## Input, judgement, output
| Input on the job | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| A HEPA vacuuming line already booked | the final cleaning is billed once | no final HEPA vacuuming line |
| No pad removal and no carpet removal line | nothing for the final cleaning to bill | no final HEPA vacuuming line |
| Pad removal or carpet removal lines, no HEPA vacuuming line | one line, dated the drying complete date | billed square feet multiplied by the tier's HEPA vacuuming rate |

## Worked figure (hypothetical job)
Inputs chosen for illustration: pad removal lines of 320 square feet, carpet removal lines of 280 square feet and an assumed HEPA vacuuming rate of $0.40 per square foot.
- Vacuumed floor: 320 plus 280, that is 600 square feet; wall, contents and plate areas zero; pass factors 1.
- Billed square feet: 600.00.
- Line amount: 600.00 multiplied by $0.40, that is $240.00.
